_comment: Single source of truth for Cy on dabblelabs.uk. Deployed verbatim to <docroot>/cy/manifest.json and read at render time by the shell (lib/display.php, dl_read_manifest). Schema: DABBLELABS_PORTFOLIO_SPEC.md. Cy lives on its own subdomain, so the card points off-site via external_url (validated against the shell's host allowlist); privacy_url/tos_url and logo are omitted because there is no on-site app page - the card links straight to cy.dabblelabs.uk.
